description: This file defines a custom assertion class 'DittoThingsAssertions' extending base assertions for testing 'Thing' objects within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides an assertion method for 'Thing' instances and is used in testing or validation contexts.

classes.name: DittoThingsAssertions
classes.description: A set of project-specific assertion methods for 'Thing' objects, extending the base assertions provided by DittoBaseAssertions.

methods.name: assertThat
methods.description: Returns a 'ThingAssert' object for the specified 'Thing', enabling fluent assertions in tests.
